title: Teach AI Agents Any Task with Skill Recorder
description:
Skill Recorder captures a real work session on your screen to turn it into a skill your AI agent can repeat.
Powered by GitHub Copilot CLI, it turns recorded actions into reusable procedures and scheduled automations.

Skill Recorder captures clicks, window switches, and voice narration locally to build native agent workflows instead of brittle UI replays.
